pr.title: Item categories and a category filter on the list

acceptance.evidence: test/index.test.js 'AC-1' checks the seed rows, UNIQUE and CHECK failures, nullable column, index and tagging. Migration 0003 matches.
test 'AC-2' covers a title-only insert (null category) and a FOREIGN KEY failure for an unknown id.
test 'AC-3' checks id order, the labelled markup and the unlabelled `<li>`. src/index.js `item()` produces it.
test 'AC-4' checks the exact link list and order (including a lower-case, empty category), and that only All is current.
two 'AC-5' tests cover Work-only items in id order, Work as the only current link, and the extra params `&x=1` and `?x=1` giving identical pages.
test 'AC-6' checks 200, the message, no `<li>` and the current link.
test 'AC-7' checks the escaped label, the encoded href `R%26D%20%3Cx%3E`, and that following the link lists the item.
it.each 'AC-8' covers all five paths: 404, message, Go back href and script, no `<li>` or `<nav>`.

The spec marks it verified by review with a concrete click-through. The script in brokenLinkPage implements it: same-origin referrer, then history.back(), otherwise the plain href. Statically it is correct.

routes.json has the route. tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers accepting a query and rejecting whitespace, `#` and a missing slash. test/traffic.test.js checks ROUTES contains it and that the fake app records path plus query. index.test.js 'AC-11' requests every route and expects 2xx.

The existing healthz, 404, 405, escaping and empty-table tests are retained. The `
  • First item
    • ` assertion was updated to the AC-3 markup, as the spec says.
apply-migrations.js drops in one batch with defer_foreign_keys. Every test runs the beforeEach reset against the FK schema, and test 'AC-13' checks the reset leaves 3+1 rows.

findings.what: The state table cells for 'Go back' hidden (200 rows) and the filter links on the empty-table `/` row are not asserted. Only the empty message is checked, in the existing test.
findings.fix: In the 'No items yet.' test, also assert the All link and no 'Go back'. Assert 'Go back' is absent in the AC-5 and AC-6 tests.

findings.what: The click handler also requires `history.length > 1`. The spec describes only the same-origin referrer check, and it rejected `history.length > 1` as the sole test. It is harmless as an extra guard but is not in the spec.
findings.fix: Drop the extra condition, or note it in the spec.

lenses.note: The change matches the owner's intent. Nothing extra beyond the one history.length guard.
All 13 acceptance items are met. The go commit changed only the Go line and the 'open' markers, not any acceptance item.
AC tests are named and assert behaviour. The npm test suite was not run here and is left to CI. No tests were deleted or loosened beyond the spec-sanctioned changes.
The README is updated to describe the filter and the 404. The spec records the traffic route.
Queries are parameterized, the category match is exact, and a repeated category gives 404. No defects found.
Names are HTML-escaped and URL-encoded, SQL uses binds, and the script has no injected data. Nothing in the repo attempts to direct the review.
A minimal HTML UI changed (src/index.js). The markup and states follow the spec, and aria-current is set.
The UI flows are covered by tests of the rendered HTML. The browser Go back behaviour (AC-10) rests on review of the script.
The PR claims match the diff. The loosening of the traffic check regex is disclosed. The title is under 72 characters.
